name: Rollins
description: Rollins is the parent of Orkin and a family of pest-control brands that protect homes and businesses from insects, rodents, wildlife and termites in about 70 countries (more than 800 company-owned and franchised locations, over two million customers). Customers pay for scheduled service plans that renew, so about 75 percent of revenue is recurring; the rest is ancillary projects (exclusion, crawlspace, insulation) and one-time treatments. Residential is 45 percent of revenue, Commercial 33 percent, Termite and ancillary 21 percent. It grows by raising prices, routing technicians efficiently and buying regional operators (acquisitions added 4.1 points to 2025 growth). It reports a single segment.

employees.note: 21,946 employees, about 19,700 in the US (about 17,560 at US branches); under 2 percent of US employees are unionised.

businessLines.name: Residential pest control
businessLines.how: Households pay for scheduled pest-prevention visits under recurring service agreements (quarterly or monthly plans plus one-off treatments for rodents, insects and wildlife); retention and price drive revenue.

businessLines.name: Commercial pest control
businessLines.how: Businesses in healthcare, food service and logistics pay for scheduled workplace pest-control contracts, often with compliance reporting; multi-year recurring service.

businessLines.name: Termite and ancillary
businessLines.how: Termite protection programmes (liquid, foam, bait, wood treatment) sold as annual renewable contracts plus one-time ancillary work such as pest and rodent exclusion, crawlspace encapsulation, moisture remediation and insulation.

brands.name: Orkin (Orkin USA, Orkin Canada, Orkin Australia)
brands.note: Lead brand; revenue by brand not disclosed

brands.name: HomeTeam Pest Defense, Clark Pest Control, Northwest Exterminating, Fox Pest Control, Saela Pest Control, Western Pest Services, Waltham Services, Industrial Fumigant Company, Trutech, Critter Control, OPC Pest Services, PermaTreat, Crane Pest Control, McCall Service, MissQuito, Aardwolf Pestkare, Safeguard
brands.note: Brands the 10-K names as part of the family; revenue by brand not disclosed
